title: Homeowners Insurance Claims: Policy in Force, Excluded Defects and Roof Settlement
content:
Three rules govern losses reported under Homeowners Insurance from Calloway Insurance Agency:

1. A loss is reported against the policy in force on the loss date.
2. Workmanship and construction defects on a Calloway home are not insured losses, and are referred to the Calloway Limited Home Warranty.
3. Roof losses settle at replacement cost until the roof is the program's roof settlement age in years old.

Each reported loss receives a claim number in the form HSC-30418, and the report records the cause of loss, the loss date and the date reported.

## Training questions and answers

**Which policy does a loss go against?**
The policy that was in force on the date of the loss. The date the loss is reported does not decide which policy it goes against.

**Is a workmanship or construction defect in a Calloway home covered?**
No. Workmanship and construction defects on a Calloway home are not insured losses under Homeowners Insurance; they are referred to the Calloway Limited Home Warranty.

**How does a roof loss settle?**
At replacement cost until the roof reaches the program's roof settlement age; after that age the roof loss settles at actual cash value.

## Illustrations (hypothetical roofs, roof settlement age of 15 years)

| Roof age at the loss | Roof loss settles at |
|---|---|
| 6 years | Replacement cost |
| 14 years | Replacement cost |
| 16 years | Actual cash value |
